isSubscribed.description: Whether the user has an active subscription.

planId.description: ID of the purchased nutrition plan.

subscriptionStartDate.description: Date when the current subscription started.

subscriptionEndDate.description: Date when the current subscription expires.

isPaused.description: Whether the user's subscription is paused.

pausedAt.description: Timestamp when the subscription was paused.

isPaymentPending.description: True if the user has submitted a payment that is awaiting verification.

Meal.title: Meal
Meal.description: A single meal within a day's diet plan.

time.description: The suggested time for the meal (e.g., '09:00').

description.description: The recipe, instructions, or details of the meal.

photoSubmitted.description: True if the client has confirmed they sent the photo on WhatsApp.

DayPlan.title: DayPlan
DayPlan.description: A collection of meals for a single day.

day.description: The day number in the plan (e.g., 1, 2, 3...).

DietPlan.title: DietPlan
DietPlan.description: Represents a multi-day diet plan created by the admin for a client.

startDate.description: The calendar date the plan begins.

NutritionPlan.title: NutritionPlan
NutritionPlan.description: Represents a nutrition plan offered by the consultant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the nutrition plan.

title.description: The title of the plan (e.g., 3-Month Transformation).

price.description: The price of the nutrition plan as a display string (e.g., 6000 INR).

description.description: Detailed description of the nutrition plan's features and benefits.

durationMonths.description: The duration of the plan in months.

features.description: A list of key features included in the plan.

isPopular.description: Marks the plan as a popular choice.

recommendation.description: Recommendation text to persuade clients to purchase this specific plan.

ClientData.title: ClientData
ClientData.description: A data entry for a client's progress, like weight or measurements. Multiple entries for different types can exist for the same date.

AdminNote.title: AdminNote
AdminNote.description: Private notes made by the admin about a client.

isActive.description: Whether the coupon is currently active.

/users/{userId}/dietPlans/{planId}.description: Stores diet plans for a specific client.

/users/{userId}/progressData/{dataId}.description: Stores progress data entries for a specific client.

/adminNotes/{noteId}.description: Stores private admin notes for all clients.
